probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __positioned between a first pair of closed ribs and a second pair of closed ribs__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure __wherein the aero cover is integrally molded as a single unit with the body panel__.

2. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner __each defining a distinct structural buttress__.

3. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure __wherein each open rib section includes a fore-aft rib with transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides thereof__.

4. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure __wherein the aero covers are separately molded and attached to the body panel__.

5. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

6. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

7. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.

8. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel.

9. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress.

10. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress __and wherein the open rib structures are configured to provide structural reinforcement while the aero covers provide aerodynamic closure__.

15. (Currently Amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress __wherein each open rib structure includes a fore-aft rib with transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides thereof__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure __and separately molded from the body panel__; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure __and separately molded from the body panel__.

16. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section __joined together__ by fasteners.

17. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section.

18. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

19. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

20. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.
